risks.impact: A Schema-only Task Packet consumer could accept an unassigned product_writer_agent_id because standard JSON Schema cannot express that cross-array identity relation.
risks.trigger: A future caller treats task-packet-v2.schema.json acceptance alone as executable authorization and bypasses validate_task_packet.
risks.mitigation: Keep the documented two-layer contract mandatory; execute only after both Draft 2020-12 validation and the standard-library manual validator succeed.
risks.residual_risk: Acceptable for this stateless synthetic MVP; runtime/OS enforcement remains outside R1.5 authority.

recommendation.reason: Candidate 25cbbfa passes independent QA on the exact frozen inputs: 87 native tests and 47 controller tests passed; the valid bundle CLI v0.5.4 passed twice with byte-identical output; all three Schema instance classes validated; static packet/bundle equal their deterministic builders; claim resolution with empty or RESULT_UNKNOWN tests is rejected by both Schema and manual validation; duplicate-builder and reviewer-write packets are rejected by both layers; and an unassigned writer is rejected by the manual pre-execution validator. The extracted tree remained byte-identical and was removed after validation.
recommendation.next_action: Proceed only with the remaining same-candidate read-only gates and synthetic black-box pilot; keep PHASE4-TASK03 frozen and do not access UAT/production or deploy.
